purpose: Review every grammar in the historical 58/291 stateful-strict translation baseline without silently treating conservative proof refusals as demonstrated bugs.

provenance.pipeline_evidence_note: Complete four-stage frozen six-configuration sweep. Current strict translation was independently rerun after the absorption proof; exact/permissive pipeline observations retain their stated earlier commit.

interpretation: All historical 58 grammars retain successful translation, generation and strict W compilation in the opt-in exact lexer + prediction configuration. This is pipeline coverage, not proof of general ANTLR runtime equivalence.
The legacy stateful permissive pipeline also passes all 58: these are strict compatibility proof refusals, not ordinary compile-coverage losses.

Only five of the 30 legacy stateful-strict refusals have maintained source-specific mismatch witnesses. The remaining 25 are conservative unproven decisions, not demonstrated incompatibilities or accepted baseline reclassifications.
The absorption proof restores SRT and SwiftFin among this historical set. Geekcode is outside the historical stateful-strict 58 and is intentionally not added to this ledger.
Historical expectation baselines are unchanged by this review.
